title: Scheduled account check matches caretaker probe for agy with file_watcher stderr and Pi with OpenCode Z.AI key
description: Seeds an agy account whose live request succeeds while printing file_watcher log lines on stderr and a Pi account whose Z.AI key comes from its OpenCode auth file; asserts both caretaker registry account probe and the loop's scheduled account check record both available, and a really failing request still records broken with the provider's sentence.

steps.name: scheduled account check matches caretaker probe and keeps provider error on real failure
